original_test_intent: Apply one explicitly approved DCMI power-limit policy through the local in-band route, verify every encoded field by source-exact readback, observe bounded policy effects and restore the complete baseline.
original_method: Preserve raw 0x2c/0x04 followed by 0x2c/0x03, but require a specification-validated complete payload, one approved write, dedicated-system controls and deterministic restoration.
manual_activity: The platform owner approves the exact action, watt limit, correction time, sampling period and byte encoding; confirms a dedicated idle SUT, maintenance window, console fallback, acceptable shutdown/SEL behavior and exact baseline restoration.
required_inputs: Approved DCMI set/get specification and decoder
Complete original power-limit tuple and enabled state
Exact action, watts, correction time and sampling period
Field ranges, byte order and reserved-byte rules
safety_requirements: One write only and no automatic retry
Abort on load, thermal, console or target mismatch
Restore the full baseline under the approved plan
agent_execution_scope: Bind the local route to intended SUT
Capture complete policy and health baseline
Validate full set and restore encodings
Read back and compare every field
engineer_actions: Approve exact tuple, action risk, maintenance window and recovery
Confirm limit is safe for fitted hardware and workload

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level command supplies only watts and cannot prove the source action, correction-time, statistics-period or reserved-byte payload; SSH is also unnecessary for a named local route unless execution topology is separately approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After complete baseline and approval, issue raw 0x2c 0x04 0xdc 0 0 0 <approved-action> <approved-watt-bytes> <approved-correction-time-bytes> 0 0 <approved-sampling-period-bytes> exactly once, then raw 0x2c 0x03 0xdc 0 0 for field-complete readback and restore under plan.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source route, opcode, listed actions, MSB-first watt statement and 10/5 timing remain; unspecified encoding, values and restore behavior are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the operation as a reversible power-policy transaction: immutable baseline, specification-checked complete payload, explicit approval, one bounded write, field-complete readback, safe effect observation and exact restore verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authorization, missing tuple semantics, workload/console interlocks and recovery beyond command success and immediate readback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The getter proves stored fields but not enforcement, exception behavior or safe restoration; the OOB baseline case covers a different access path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Action 0x01 can abruptly power off the server and lose workload state; 0x11 can create SEL records; an unsafe limit or timing window can throttle or destabilize the platform.

project_override_considerations: A high-level or Redfish setter is acceptable only when all source fields and semantics map exactly, the local-route coverage difference is declared, and complete baseline/readback/restore evidence remains available.
expected_evidence: SUT/BMC/local-route identity and approved DCMI contract
Complete decoded baseline including enabled state
Workload quiescence, thermal/power health and console fallback
Exact redacted set request/response and completion
Field-complete getter comparison and bounded action/SEL evidence
Exact restore request, readback and final health
No unrelated power, thermal, firmware, configuration or log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, raw setter, field list, getter and readback criterion consistently describe an in-band Set Power Limit test. Missing exact values, incomplete byte-order detail and absent recovery are readiness gaps, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target operation and policy fields are identifiable. Specification, exact values, dedicated-system controls, approval and restore are concrete prerequisites rather than irreducible ambiguity.

review_improvement: Expands a watt-only partial command into an approved, complete and reversible DCMI power-policy transaction with explicit shutdown protection.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source payload controls more than a numeric cap: action 0x01 may hard-power the host, action 0x11 changes SEL behavior, and correction/sampling windows determine when the limit is judged and enforced. A safe test therefore cannot accept a watt-only high-level setter. It must encode one approved tuple, prove the prior policy, maintain console recovery, verify all fields and restore exactly; automatic retry is unsafe because a delayed enforcement action could occur after the first write appeared inconclusive.
